cohort: The study included 447 pregnant women who delivered at Babcock University Teaching Hospital (BUTH) in southwestern Nigeria.
finding: Advanced maternal age, low birth order, history of CS, and non-cephalic presentation predicted elective CS, while low birth order, history of CS, and gestational age 37-40 weeks predicted non-elective CS, with non-elective CS being associated with higher fetal morbidities.
mod_finding: Fetal morbidities such as birth asphyxia, prematurity, and low birth weight were significantly higher in women who had non-elective CS compared to those who had elective CS.
